# BYZ scope. 西方援助意愿 (the West's will to help), 0-100 (design 3.5). Read only: not stored and with no monthly drift,

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_uni } add = { value = var:oe_ecc_uni divide = 2 } } else = { add = 5 }
    # union with Rome (L4, gen_union.py: talks +5, signed +15, proclaimed +25, repudiated -10) or a Catholic empire

    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_br_western_aid } add = 5 }

    if = { limit = { is_situation_active = situation:western_schism } add = -15 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hcr_crusade_cd } add = -20 }
    min = 0
    max = 100
}

# Any scope. The AI's weight for .23 a, calling the crusade (design 3.9): 10 + (papal authority - 50) / 2, +20 for a
# union in force or a Catholic empire, + the Papal States' opinion of the empire / 5; at least 0. The option itself is
# hidden when vanilla's rules forbid the crusade (oe_lat_pope_can_crusade).

    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP country_exists = c:BYZ } add = { value = "c:PAP.opinion(c:BYZ)" divide = 5 } }
    min = 0
}

# BYZ scope. N-1: the chance in percent that Lithuania takes baptism from the East (design 3.3): 8, +4 while Moscow is at
# peace with Lithuania, +4 when 20+ places of Lithuania are mostly Orthodox, -4 while the empire is the Ottomans' subject;
# 0-20 (.30 a shows it).
oe_latn_east_chance = {
    value = 8
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MOS country_exists = c:LIT NOT = { c:LIT = { is_at_war_with = c:MOS } } } add = 4 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LIT c:LIT = { any_owned_location = { count >= 20 dominant_religion = religion:orthodox } } } add = 4 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR is_subject_of = c:TUR } add = -4 }
    min = 0
    max = 20
    # test buttons only (oe_latn_force: 1 sure, 2 never)
    if = { limit = { var:oe_latn_force ?= 1 } value = 100 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_latn_force ?= 2 } value = 0 }
}

# Any scope. oe_latn_flags (design 3.7): ones N-1 (1 baptised from the East, 2 missed), tens N-2 (1 the Order beaten,
# 2 stalemate), hundreds N-4 (1 handed over, 2 nothing left); phase 6 adds the thousands (N-7) and ten thousands.
oe_latn_flags = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_east } add = { value = global_var:oe_latn_east multiply = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_thorn } add = { value = global_var:oe_latn_thorn multiply = 10 } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_latn_melno } add = { value = global_var:oe_latn_melno multiply = 100 } }
}
# Any scope. Lithuania's faith: -1 gone, 0 not Christian, 1 Orthodox, 2 Catholic, 3 another Christian church.
oe_latn_rd_litrel = {
    value = -1
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LIT } value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LIT c:LIT = { religion.group = religion_group:christian } } value = 3 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LIT c:LIT = { religion = religion:orthodox } } value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LIT c:LIT = { religion = religion:catholic } } value = 2 }
}
# Any scope. D2's see of Lithuania (global oe_ecc_see_lit; -1 unset) and the Order's treasury (0 when it is gone).
oe_latn_rd_see = { value = -1 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ecc_see_lit } value = global_var:oe_ecc_see_lit } }
oe_latn_rd_teug = { value = 0 if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TEU } value = c:TEU.gold } }
